title: Rory and the Velvet Clover Cove
verses:
The velvet cove was warm and wide,
The silver stars began to glow,
Where Rory walked along the tide,
With footsteps quiet, soft, and slow.

Then Nia drifted from the sky,
To rest upon the fragrant green,
While Ricky watched the clouds go by,
Inside the quiet, peaceful scene.

Now Tilly rested on the hill,
Where Benny made a soothing sound,
The forest air grew very still,
Above the cozy, mossy ground.

Then Psittaco began a song,
Before he found a clover nest,
Where Rory softly hummed along,
To help the drowsy valley rest.

The quiet shadows softly fell,
Across the cozy clover glade,
Where Rory knew that all was well,
Beneath the cool and peaceful shade.

The moon shone down a silver light,
To wrap the resting world in sleep,
As Rory whispered soft, "Goodnight,"
Before his dreams grew warm and deep.
